+# The Daily Grind
+
+## Encrypted delivery notes
+
+Customers can write private delivery notes (gate codes, allergies) on the homepage. Each note is encrypted in the browser before it is sent, so only the store can read it.
+
+- **Shared secret:** each note encapsulates a fresh secret to the store's public key.
+  - `XWING-768` (default): hybrid X25519 key agreement plus ML-KEM-768 post-quantum encapsulation (X-Wing).
+  - `MLKEM-1024`: post-quantum only.
+- **Key derivation:** HKDF-SHA-256 derives a one-time AES-256-GCM key. The suite, key id and store public key are part of the derivation input.
+- **Authenticated encryption:** AES-256-GCM. The envelope header (suite, key id, order ref, timestamp, KEM ciphertext) is authenticated as associated data.
+- **Key pinning:** the page only accepts store keys whose fingerprints were built into the bundle.
+
+| Command | Purpose |
+| --- | --- |
+| `pnpm keys:generate` | Create new store key pairs. Public keys go to `keys/`; secret keys go to `secrets/`, which is git-ignored and must never be published. |
+| `pnpm build` | Bundle `src/delivery-notes/` into `assets/delivery-notes.js` and pin the current key fingerprints. |
+| `pnpm notes:decrypt <envelope.json>` | Decrypt a note on the store side. |
+| `pnpm test` | Run the crypto tests: round trips, tamper detection, wrong key, suite downgrade, key validation. |
+
+The page sends envelopes to `POST /api/delivery-notes`. If that endpoint isn't available, the ciphertext is kept in `sessionStorage` (`dailygrind.pendingDeliveryNote`) so it can be attached at checkout.

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// Store-side key management for encrypted delivery notes.
+//
+//   node scripts/delivery-keys.mjs generate [--days 365]
+//       Creates fresh X-Wing (hybrid) and ML-KEM-1024 key pairs.
+//       Public bundle  -> keys/delivery-notes-keys.json (commit & publish)
+//       Secret keyring -> secrets/delivery-notes-keyring.json  (NEVER commit; mode 0600)
+//       Old secret keys are kept in the keyring so earlier notes stay readable.
+//
+//   node scripts/delivery-keys.mjs decrypt <envelope.json | ->
+//       Decrypts a note envelope using the local secret keyring.
+import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, chmod } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import { SUITES, generateStoreKey, openNote, toB64u, fromB64u, ENVELOPE_VERSION } from '../src/delivery-notes/crypto.js';
+
+const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
+const PUBLIC_PATH = join(root, 'keys', 'delivery-notes-keys.json');
+const KEYRING_PATH = process.env.DELIVERY_NOTES_KEYRING || join(root, 'secrets', 'delivery-notes-keyring.json');
+
+async function loadKeyring() {
+  if (!existsSync(KEYRING_PATH)) return { v: ENVELOPE_VERSION, keys: [] };
+  return JSON.parse(await readFile(KEYRING_PATH, 'utf8'));
+}
+
+function keyringMap(raw) {
+  const map = Object.create(null);
+  for (const k of raw.keys) {
+    map[k.kid] = { suite: k.suite, publicKey: fromB64u(k.publicKey), secretKey: fromB64u(k.secretKey) };
+  }
+  return map;
+}
+
+async function generate(days) {
+  const now = new Date();
+  const expires = new Date(now.getTime() + days * 86400e3).toISOString();
+  const stamp = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '');
+  const keyring = await loadKeyring();
+  const published = [];
+  for (const suiteId of Object.keys(SUITES)) {
+    const rand = toB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(4)));
+    const kid = `${suiteId.toLowerCase()}-${stamp}-${rand}`;
+    const k = await generateStoreKey(suiteId, kid);
+    keyring.keys.push({
+      suite: k.suite, kid, created: now.toISOString(), expires,
+      publicKey: toB64u(k.publicKey), secretKey: toB64u(k.secretKey),
+    });
+    published.push({ suite: k.suite, kid, expires, publicKey: toB64u(k.publicKey), fingerprint: k.fingerprint });
+    k.secretKey.fill(0);
+    console.log(`${suiteId.padEnd(11)} ${kid}  fp=${k.fingerprint}`);
+  }
+  await mkdir(dirname(KEYRING_PATH), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
+  await writeFile(KEYRING_PATH, JSON.stringify(keyring, null, 2) + '\n', { mode: 0o600 });
+  await chmod(KEYRING_PATH, 0o600);
+  await mkdir(dirname(PUBLIC_PATH), { recursive: true });
+  await writeFile(PUBLIC_PATH, JSON.stringify({ v: ENVELOPE_VERSION, keys: published }, null, 2) + '\n');
+  console.log(`\nPublic bundle: ${PUBLIC_PATH}\nSecret keyring: ${KEYRING_PATH} (keep offline / in a secrets manager)`);
+  console.log('Run `pnpm build` to re-pin the new fingerprints into the page bundle.');
+}
+
+async function decrypt(file) {
+  const text = file === '-' || !file
+    ? await new Promise((res) => { let s = ''; process.stdin.on('data', (d) => (s += d)).on('end', () => res(s)); })
+    : await readFile(file, 'utf8');
+  const env = JSON.parse(text);
+  const note = await openNote(env, keyringMap(await loadKeyring()));
+  console.log(`Order:   ${env.orderRef || '(none)'}\nCreated: ${env.createdAt}\nSuite:   ${env.suite} (${env.kid})\n\n${note}`);
+}
+
+const [cmd, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);
+try {
+  if (cmd === 'generate') {
+    const i = rest.indexOf('--days');
+    const days = i >= 0 ? Number(rest[i + 1]) : 365;
+    if (!Number.isFinite(days) || days <= 0) throw new Error('--days must be a positive number');
+    await generate(days);
+  } else if (cmd === 'decrypt') {
+    await decrypt(rest[0]);
+  } else {
+    console.error('Usage: delivery-keys.mjs generate [--days N] | decrypt <envelope.json|->');
+    process.exit(2);
+  }
+} catch (e) {
+  console.error(`Error: ${e.message}`);
+  process.exit(1);
+}

+} from './crypto.js';

+const PENDING_KEY = 'dailygrind.pendingDeliveryNote';

+
+const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
+
+function setStatus(el, kind, text) {
+  el.className = `dn-status dn-${kind}`;
+  el.textContent = text; // never innerHTML

+
+function groupFp(fp) {
+  return fp.slice(0, 32).match(/.{4}/g).join(' ');
+}
+
+let bundlePromise;
+function loadBundle() {
+  bundlePromise ??= fetch(KEY_BUNDLE_URL, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-cache' })
+    .then((r) => {
+      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`Could not load store key (HTTP ${r.status})`);
+      return r.json();
+    })
+    .catch((e) => { bundlePromise = undefined; throw e; });
+  return bundlePromise;
+}
+
+async function currentRecipient(suiteId) {
+  return selectRecipientKey(await loadBundle(), suiteId, PINNED && PINNED.length ? PINNED : undefined);
+}
+
+async function submitEnvelope(envelope) {
+  try {
+    const r = await fetch(SUBMIT_URL, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      credentials: 'same-origin',
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+      body: JSON.stringify(envelope),
+    });
+    if (r.ok) return 'sent';
+  } catch { /* offline or no API on this host */ }
+  // Only ciphertext is ever stored; it is attached at checkout.
+  sessionStorage.setItem(PENDING_KEY, JSON.stringify(envelope));
+  return 'queued';
+}
+
+function init() {
+  const form = $('dn-form');
+  if (!form) return;
+  const note = $('dn-note');
+  const orderRef = $('dn-order');
+  const counter = $('dn-count');
+  const status = $('dn-status');
+  const keyInfo = $('dn-keyinfo');
+  const submit = $('dn-submit');
+  const result = $('dn-result');
+
+  note.maxLength = MAX_NOTE_CHARS;

+
+  async function showKey() {

+      submit.disabled = false;
+    } catch (e) {
+      keyInfo.textContent = '';
+      submit.disabled = true;
+      setStatus(status, 'error', e.message);

+  }

+    } finally {

+    }

+}

+// Encrypted delivery notes: shared crypto core (browser + Node >= 20).
+//
+// Construction (one-shot, sender -> store; similar to HPKE base mode):
+//
+//   1. KEM: encapsulate a fresh shared secret to the store's published public key.
+//        - "XWING-768"   : X-Wing hybrid KEM = X25519 key agreement + ML-KEM-768
+//                          (draft-connolly-cfrg-xwing-kem). Secure if EITHER
+//                          component holds -> classical + post-quantum protection.
+//        - "MLKEM-1024"  : pure post-quantum ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203).
+//   2. KDF: HKDF-SHA-256(ikm = sharedSecret, salt = SHA-256(kemCiphertext),
+//           info = label || suite || kid || SHA-256(recipientPublicKey))
+//      -> one-time, non-extractable AES-256-GCM key.
+//   3. AEAD: AES-256-GCM with a random 96-bit IV. The canonical envelope header
+//      (version, suite, kid, order reference, timestamp, KEM ciphertext) is the
+//      additional authenticated data, so none of it can be altered or swapped.
+//
+// The suite identifier is bound into both the KDF info and the AAD, so an
+// attacker cannot downgrade or mix suites without failing authentication.
+
+import { ml_kem768_x25519 } from '@noble/post-quantum/hybrid.js';
+import { ml_kem1024 } from '@noble/post-quantum/ml-kem.js';
+
+export const ENVELOPE_VERSION = 1;
+export const MAX_NOTE_CHARS = 1000;
+const LABEL = 'DailyGrind/delivery-notes/v1';
+
+/** Allow-listed suites. Anything else is rejected. */
+export const SUITES = Object.freeze({
+  'XWING-768': Object.freeze({
+    id: 'XWING-768',
+    name: 'Hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 (X-Wing)',
+    kem: ml_kem768_x25519,
+  }),
+  'MLKEM-1024': Object.freeze({
+    id: 'MLKEM-1024',
+    name: 'Post-quantum ML-KEM-1024',
+    kem: ml_kem1024,
+  }),
+});
+export const DEFAULT_SUITE = 'XWING-768';
+
+const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle;
+const enc = new TextEncoder();
+const dec = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true });
+
+function requireSubtle() {
+  if (!subtle || !globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues) {
+    throw new Error('Secure WebCrypto is unavailable (an HTTPS connection is required).');
+  }
+}
+
+export function getSuite(id) {
+  if (typeof id !== 'string' || !Object.hasOwn(SUITES, id)) {
+    throw new Error(`Unsupported encryption suite: ${String(id)}`);
+  }
+  return SUITES[id];
+}
+
+// ---------- encoding helpers ----------
+
+export function toB64u(bytes) {
+  let s = '';
+  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) {
+    s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
+  }
+  return btoa(s).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
+}
+
+export function fromB64u(str) {
+  if (typeof str !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/.test(str)) {
+    throw new Error('Invalid base64url data');
+  }
+  const b64 = str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/') + '='.repeat((4 - (str.length % 4)) % 4);
+  const bin = atob(b64);
+  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
+  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
+  return out;
+}
+
+function concat(...parts) {
+  const out = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0));
+  let o = 0;
+  for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, o); o += p.length; }
+  return out;
+}
+
+/** Length-prefixed encoding so concatenated fields are unambiguous. */
+function lp(bytes) {
+  const len = new Uint8Array(4);
+  new DataView(len.buffer).setUint32(0, bytes.length);
+  return concat(len, bytes);
+}
+
+export async function sha256(bytes) {
+  requireSubtle();
+  return new Uint8Array(await subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes));
+}
+
+/** Human-comparable key fingerprint: hex SHA-256 over suite id + public key. */
+export async function fingerprint(suiteId, publicKey) {
+  const h = await sha256(concat(lp(enc.encode(suiteId)), lp(publicKey)));
+  return Array.from(h, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
+}
+
+function wipe(...arrays) {
+  for (const a of arrays) if (a && typeof a.fill === 'function') a.fill(0);
+}
+
+// ---------- key schedule ----------
+
+async function deriveAeadKey({ suiteId, kid, sharedSecret, kemCiphertext, publicKey, usage }) {
+  const salt = await sha256(kemCiphertext);
+  const info = concat(
+    lp(enc.encode(LABEL)),
+    lp(enc.encode(suiteId)),
+    lp(enc.encode(kid)),
+    lp(await sha256(publicKey)),
+  );
+  const ikm = await subtle.importKey('raw', sharedSecret, 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
+  return subtle.deriveKey(
+    { name: 'HKDF', hash: 'SHA-256', salt, info },
+    ikm,
+    { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
+    false, // non-extractable
+    [usage],
+  );
+}
+
+/** Canonical, field-ordered header bytes used as AEAD associated data. */
+function headerAad(h) {
+  return enc.encode(JSON.stringify([
+    LABEL, h.v, h.suite, h.kid, h.orderRef, h.createdAt, h.enc,
+  ]));
+}
+
+function validateOrderRef(orderRef) {
+  if (typeof orderRef !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,40}$/.test(orderRef)) {
+    throw new Error('Order reference may only contain letters, digits and dashes (max 40).');
+  }
+  return orderRef;
+}
+
+// ---------- recipient key bundle ----------
+
+/**
+ * Parse and validate the store's published key bundle. Returns the recipient
+ * entry for the requested suite. If `pinnedFingerprints` is supplied the key
+ * must match one of them.
+ */
+export async function selectRecipientKey(bundle, suiteId, pinnedFingerprints) {
+  const suite = getSuite(suiteId);
+  if (!bundle || bundle.v !== ENVELOPE_VERSION || !Array.isArray(bundle.keys)) {
+    throw new Error('Malformed delivery-notes key bundle');
+  }
+  const entry = bundle.keys.find((k) => k && k.suite === suite.id);
+  if (!entry || typeof entry.kid !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(entry.kid)) {
+    throw new Error(`Store has not published a ${suite.name} key`);
+  }
+  if (entry.expires && Date.parse(entry.expires) < Date.now()) {
+    throw new Error('The store encryption key has expired');
+  }
+  const publicKey = fromB64u(entry.publicKey);
+  if (publicKey.length !== suite.kem.lengths.publicKey) {
+    throw new Error('Store public key has an invalid length');
+  }
+  const fp = await fingerprint(suite.id, publicKey);
+  if (entry.fingerprint && entry.fingerprint !== fp) {
+    throw new Error('Store public key fingerprint mismatch');
+  }
+  if (pinnedFingerprints && !pinnedFingerprints.includes(fp)) {
+    throw new Error('Store public key is not pinned by this page');
+  }
+  return { suite: suite.id, kid: entry.kid, publicKey, fingerprint: fp };
+}
+
+// ---------- seal / open ----------
+
+/**
+ * Encrypt a note to the recipient. Returns a JSON-serialisable envelope.
+ * @param {{suite:string,kid:string,publicKey:Uint8Array}} recipient
+ * @param {string} note
+ * @param {{orderRef?:string, now?:Date}} [opts]
+ */
+export async function sealNote(recipient, note, opts = {}) {
+  requireSubtle();
+  const suite = getSuite(recipient.suite);
+  if (typeof note !== 'string' || note.trim().length === 0) throw new Error('Note is empty');
+  if ([...note].length > MAX_NOTE_CHARS) throw new Error(`Note exceeds ${MAX_NOTE_CHARS} characters`);
+
+  const { cipherText: kemCiphertext, sharedSecret } = suite.kem.encapsulate(recipient.publicKey);
+  const plaintext = enc.encode(note);
+  try {
+    const key = await deriveAeadKey({
+      suiteId: suite.id, kid: recipient.kid, sharedSecret, kemCiphertext,
+      publicKey: recipient.publicKey, usage: 'encrypt',
+    });
+    const header = {
+      v: ENVELOPE_VERSION,
+      suite: suite.id,
+      kid: recipient.kid,
+      orderRef: validateOrderRef(opts.orderRef ?? ''),
+      createdAt: (opts.now ?? new Date()).toISOString(),
+      enc: toB64u(kemCiphertext),
+    };
+    const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
+    const ct = new Uint8Array(await subtle.encrypt(
+      { name: 'AES-GCM', iv, additionalData: headerAad(header), tagLength: 128 },
+      key,
+      plaintext,
+    ));
+    return { ...header, iv: toB64u(iv), ct: toB64u(ct) };
+  } finally {
+    wipe(sharedSecret, plaintext);
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Decrypt an envelope (store side). `keyring` maps kid -> {suite, publicKey, secretKey}.
+ */
+export async function openNote(envelope, keyring) {
+  requireSubtle();
+  if (!envelope || envelope.v !== ENVELOPE_VERSION) throw new Error('Unsupported envelope version');
+  const suite = getSuite(envelope.suite);
+  const k = Object.hasOwn(keyring, envelope.kid) ? keyring[envelope.kid] : undefined;
+  if (!k || k.suite !== suite.id) throw new Error('No matching store key for this note');
+  validateOrderRef(envelope.orderRef);
+  if (typeof envelope.createdAt !== 'string') throw new Error('Malformed envelope');
+
+  const kemCiphertext = fromB64u(envelope.enc);
+  if (kemCiphertext.length !== suite.kem.lengths.cipherText) throw new Error('Malformed KEM ciphertext');
+  const iv = fromB64u(envelope.iv);
+  if (iv.length !== 12) throw new Error('Malformed IV');
+  const ct = fromB64u(envelope.ct);
+
+  const sharedSecret = suite.kem.decapsulate(kemCiphertext, k.secretKey);
+  try {
+    const key = await deriveAeadKey({
+      suiteId: suite.id, kid: envelope.kid, sharedSecret, kemCiphertext,
+      publicKey: k.publicKey, usage: 'decrypt',
+    });
+    let pt;
+    try {
+      pt = new Uint8Array(await subtle.decrypt(
+        { name: 'AES-GCM', iv, additionalData: headerAad(envelope), tagLength: 128 },
+        key,
+        ct,
+      ));
+    } catch {
+      throw new Error('Authentication failed: note was tampered with or encrypted to a different key');
+    }
+    try { return dec.decode(pt); } finally { wipe(pt); }
+  } finally {
+    wipe(sharedSecret);
+  }
+}
+
+/** Generate a store key pair for a suite (store side only). */
+export async function generateStoreKey(suiteId, kid) {
+  const suite = getSuite(suiteId);
+  const { publicKey, secretKey } = suite.kem.keygen();
+  return { suite: suite.id, kid, publicKey, secretKey, fingerprint: await fingerprint(suite.id, publicKey) };
+}

+# Field INP monitoring
+
+The homepage loads `/js/inp-monitor.js` (async, no dependencies). It measures
+[Interaction to Next Paint](https://web.dev/articles/inp) for real visitors and
+explains *why* slow interactions are slow.
+
+## How it works
+
+| Signal | API | Used for |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Interaction latency | Event Timing (`event`, `first-input`) | INP value (98th percentile over the page's interactions), target element, phases |
+| Script & render attribution | Long Animation Frames (`long-animation-frame`) | Which scripts ran, which phase they delayed, style/layout/paint cost |
+
+Each interaction is split into the three INP phases:
+
+- **inputDelay**: from the user's input to the first event handler starting (main thread busy with other work, often timers or third-party tags).
+- **processingDuration**: time spent in event handlers.
+- **presentationDelay**: from the end of the handlers to the next paint (rendering work).
+
+Every script in an overlapping long animation frame is assigned to the phase it
+overlapped most. Frame rendering time is broken down into animation-frame callbacks,
+style & layout (including forced synchronous layout), and paint/composite.
+
+## Configuration
+
+```html
+<script src="/js/inp-monitor.js"
+        data-endpoint="/api/rum/inp"   <!-- POST target for beacons -->
+        data-sample-rate="1"           <!-- 0..1 share of page views reported -->
+        data-slow-threshold="200"      <!-- ms; interactions this slow or slower are sent individually -->
+        async></script>
+```
+
+Debug locally with `?inp-debug` (or `localStorage.inpDebug = "1"`). Every interaction
+is then logged to the console with its phase, script and rendering tables.
+`window.dailyGrindINP.getINP()` returns the current value and its attribution.
+
+## Beacon payload
+
+A beacon is sent with `navigator.sendBeacon` (falling back to `fetch` with `keepalive`)
+when the page is hidden or unloaded, and only if something changed since the last one:
+
+```jsonc
+{
+  "v": 1,
+  "pageId": "lr3x…",              // unique per page view (reset on bfcache restore)
+  "url": "https://…/",
+  "final": true,
+  "sampleRate": 1,
+  "inp": {                        // null if unchanged since last beacon
+    "value": 336, "rating": "needs-improvement", "interactionCount": 3,
+    "interaction": { /* see below */ }
+  },
+  "slowInteractions": [ /* interactions >= slow threshold, max 20 per page */ ],
+  "context": { "navigationType": "navigate", "deviceMemory": 8, "hardwareConcurrency": 8,
+               "effectiveType": "4g", "saveData": false, "viewport": "390x844", "userAgent": "…" }
+}
+```
+
+Interaction object:
+
+```jsonc
+{
+  "type": "pointer", "eventTypes": ["pointerdown", "click"],
+  "target": "header.hero>a.btn", "duration": 336, "loadState": "complete",
+  "attribution": {
+    "phases": { "inputDelay": 35, "processingDuration": 210, "presentationDelay": 91 },
+    "dominantPhase": "processing",
+    "primaryCause": "processing: /js/app.js#onOrderClick (event-listener)",
+    "scriptsByPhase": { "input-delay": 35, "processing": 200, "presentation": 0 },
+    "rendering": {
+      "totalScriptDuration": 235, "forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration": 30,
+      "renderCallbacksDuration": 20, "styleAndLayoutDuration": 40,
+      "paintAndCompositeDuration": 26, "unattributedDuration": 15
+    },
+    "longestScript": { /* same shape as scripts[] */ },
+    "scripts": [{ "phase": "processing", "durationInInteraction": 200,
+                  "sourceURL": "https://…/js/app.js", "sourceFunctionName": "onOrderClick",
+                  "sourceCharPosition": 1234, "invoker": "A.onclick", "invokerType": "event-listener",
+                  "forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration": 30, "thirdParty": false }],
+    "scriptsBySource": [{ "sourceURL": "…", "thirdParty": false, "duration": 200, "count": 1 }],
+    "blockingDuration": 270, "loafCount": 1, "loafSupported": true
+  }
+}
+```
+
+## Suggested dashboard queries
+
+- **p75 INP** of `inp.value` per URL and device class (use one row per `pageId`, keeping the last beacon).
+- **Worst offenders**: group `slowInteractions[].attribution.scriptsBySource[]` by `sourceURL` and sum `duration`; split by `thirdParty`.
+- **Phase mix**: average `phases` per `target` to tell blocked main thread (input delay), heavy handlers (processing) and rendering cost (presentation) apart.
+- **Load-time contention**: share of slow interactions by `loadState`.
+
+## Browser support
+
+Event Timing (with `interactionId`) is available in Chromium and recent Firefox. Long Animation Frames is
+Chromium only (123+). Without it, beacons still contain the phase breakdown, with
+`loafSupported: false`. Browsers without Event Timing (Safari) don't load the monitor.
+
+## Backend
+
+This is a static site, so nothing serves `/api/rum/inp` yet. Point `data-endpoint` at
+your RUM collector, or add a handler that stores the JSON body. Beacons that fail are
+dropped silently.
